lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and says He will put hooks in his jaws.
Persia, Cush, Put, Gomer and Beth-togarmah from the far north will come with Gog.
In the latter years Gog will enter a land recovered from war, on the mountains of Lebanon.
Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Egypt ask Gog whether he has come to carry off silver and gold.
God proclaims a great earthquake and says He will judge Gog with plague, bloodshed, torrents of rain, hailstones, fire and sulfur.
